note: BH-9410: the culprit window of the --causes rule and the tick line's causes= field. A member PR whose merge-conductor eject-cause line (cause batch-red or checks) is at most this many seconds after a red batch was created is that batch's culprit. 7200 covers a slow batch run plus the conductor tick. A value outside 600..86400 is the default. Settings key lane.ci-batch-red-report.ci_batch_red_eject_window_s.
